spans.s:
There is the single substitution of the first vowel, when a simple vowel is followed by the अ of the case ending अम्।

Terms: संहितायाम्

After a Pronominal अङ्ग (stem) ending in a अ or आ the affix आम् of the Genitive 6th-Case plural gets the augment स् at the beginning.

Terms: छन्दस् substitution
